tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search ACEL published entities by natural-language need, category and locality. Returns trust state, canonical source and provenance.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Return one published ACEL entity with current facts, provenance and trust state.

tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Search entities and return observed product, service, price, availability and ordering-route facts.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Return source-linked evidence and current facts supporting an ACEL entity representation.

tools.name: compare_entities
tools.description: Compare published ACEL entities against a stated requirement using observed facts and readiness metadata.
